title: Fragment X. Andrew of Caesarea, preface to the Apocalypse

segments.text: With regard however to the inspiration of the book (i.e. the Apocalypse) we hold it superfluous to speak at length; since the blessed Gregory (I mean, the Divine) and Cyril, and men of an older generation as well, Papias, Irenæus, Methodius and Hippolytus, bear testimony to its genuineness.
Andreas of Cæsarea, preface to the Apocalypse.
